endpoints.name: WF(K): complete conditioned posterior residual
endpoints.quantifiers: There exists finite K such that for every n and every Boolean f on the uniform n-cube there exist an admissible ordered gate representation, fractional incidence weights, and for every nonempty spectral A a law on distinct actual finite partition-forest runs producing A, for which J_f <= K I(f).
endpoints.residual: J_f = v(Lambda+log2 Z) + sum_{A nonempty} P_f(A)[E B_lambda(A;r)-H(P_A)].
endpoints.tensor_admission: Universal quantifier includes every tensor power; no factorized optimal forest may be assumed.

endpoints.name: STEP(K): relevant-coordinate physical restriction
endpoints.quantifiers: There exists finite K such that for every n and every nonconstant Boolean f there exists a coordinate i with I_i(f)>0 and Delta_i H(f)<=K I_i(f).
endpoints.exact_identity: Delta_i H = H(1_{i in S}|S without i)+JS(r_+,r_-).
endpoints.unpaid_term: Dimension-free existential selection; all-coordinate, maximum-influence, and fixed-price rare-refund variants are refuted.
endpoints.tensor_admission: For a coordinate of a disjoint tensor factor, Delta_i H and I_i are unchanged; arbitrary seed ratios persist.

endpoints.name: DOWN(K): signed downward entropy
endpoints.quantifiers: There exists finite K such that for every n and every real signed array a with sum a_A^2=1 and sum_A a_A a_{A triangle U}=0 for all nonempty U, L(a)<=K sum_A |A|a_A^2.
endpoints.functional: L=sum_A p_A sum_{i in A} log2(1+p_{A without i}/p_A), p_A=a_A^2.
endpoints.unpaid_term: Use the complete signed autocorrelation system to bound L; fixed-prefix or unsigned constraints are insufficient.
endpoints.tensor_admission: L and I are additive for disjoint Boolean products, so arbitrary seed tensor powers persist.

calibrations.addressing: Coordinatewise witness pressure can be quadratic; whole-forest posterior/root accounting is O(I).
calibrations.B05_sparse_defect: Control-first and selector-first carry a k+log2(e)+o(1) normalized rare logarithm; no every-coordinate fixed-price inference is permitted.
calibrations.B19_biased_AND: Any scalar correction to J<=M requires Omega(p log2(1/p)) along the proved-pending-review fixed-q family.
